$schema: Dated, artifact-backed verification records for the detectors no parser can score.
$why: 16 of the 19 tools in detector-matrix.json are manual-verdict: their result is a page a human reads, not a value a script can extract without becoming a second, unmaintained detector. Automating them badly would be worse than not automating them - a parser that silently mis-scores browserleaks turns a red result green. So they are a LEDGER instead: every claim that a detector passes has a date, an engine build, a scenario and a screenshot behind it, and detector-checklist.mjs prints exactly which claims have none.
$howToAdd: Run the scenario per docs/OPERATIONS.md, save the capture under ci/validation/reports/, then append an entry here. `node ci/validation/detector-checklist.mjs --check` validates the shape; it never invents a verdict.

$entrySchema.engineBuild: Lobium version the run used, e.g. 152.0.7977.42
$entrySchema.artifact: repo-relative path to the screenshot or capture that backs the verdict
$entrySchema.notes: what the reviewer saw; required for anything other than a clean pass
